```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate-versions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Verify version consistency
        run: |
          # Extract versions from pubspec.yaml files
          MCP_VERSION=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_mcp/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          FLUTTER_VERSION=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_flutter/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          
          echo "marionette_mcp version: $MCP_VERSION"
          echo "marionette_flutter version: $FLUTTER_VERSION"
          
          if [ "$MCP_VERSION" != "$FLUTTER_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Error: Version mismatch! marionette_mcp ($MCP_VERSION) != marionette_flutter ($FLUTTER_VERSION)"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "Versions match: $MCP_VERSION"

      - name: Generate version.g.dart
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_mcp/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          cat > packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart << EOF
          // Generated file. Do not edit.
          // This file is generated by the CI workflow.
          
          const String marionetteMcpVersion = '$VERSION';
          EOF

      - name: Check for uncommitted changes in version.g.dart
        run: |
          if ! git diff --quiet packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart; then
            echo "Error: version.g.dart is out of sync with pubspec.yaml"
            echo "Please run the CI locally or update the file manually."
            git diff packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart
            exit 1
          fi

  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate-versions
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Analyze marionette_mcp
        run: dart analyze
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

      - name: Analyze marionette_flutter
        run: dart analyze
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate-versions
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Run tests (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart test
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

      - name: Run tests (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart test
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

  security-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: validate-versions
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Check for vulnerabilities (marionette_mcp)
        run: dart pub outdated --no-dev
        working-directory: packages/marionette_mcp

      - name: Install dependencies (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart pub get
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter

      - name: Check for vulnerabilities (marionette_flutter)
        run: dart pub outdated --no-dev
        working-directory: packages/marionette_flutter
```
